implement-feature.description: Implement a new feature from description
implement-feature.template: Implement the following feature: {task}. Follow existing code patterns, add appropriate tests, and ensure all existing tests pass.

fix-bug.template: Fix the following bug: {task}. Investigate the root cause, implement a fix, add regression tests, and verify the fix resolves the issue.

refactor-code.description: Refactor existing code for better structure
refactor-code.template: Refactor the following code: {task}. Improve code structure, readability, and maintainability while preserving functionality.

add-tests.template: Add comprehensive tests for: {task}. Cover edge cases, error conditions, and typical usage patterns.

code-review.description: Review code changes for quality and issues
code-review.template: Review the following code changes: {task}. Check for bugs, security issues, performance problems, and adherence to coding standards.

architecture-suggestion.template: Analyze the current architecture and suggest improvements for: {task}. Consider scalability, maintainability, and best practices.
